data.narrative:
Plantd Materials is a Series B-stage company in Housing & Construction founded by Nathan Silvernail, Huade Tan, and Josh Dorfman. The company has raised $42M to date. The valuation universe comprises four private peers in the same sector (Cuby Technologies, Cover, Somos, and Charge Robotics); no direct public comparables are available for this frontier subsector.

The analysis applies a stage-progression method, using total capital raised ($42M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the next funding round. This approach yields an implied valuation of $80M. Given the single-method limitation and inherent uncertainty in frontier-tech valuations, a triangulated range of $68M to $92M (low to high) is supported, with $80M as the median point.

Key uncertainties center on the limited comp set—with only four private precedents and no public trading data—which constrains confidence in stage-based multipliers. The 1.9x step-up reflects historical patterns but may not fully capture Plantd's specific market dynamics, capital efficiency, or technical progress. Additional data on peer funding rounds, revenue multiples if applicable, or comparable exit valuations would materially improve conviction. The $68M–$92M range should be treated as indicative pending deeper operational and financial diligence.
